description: §66.12.2: a bounded length `1..=3` lets `@xs` grow within the bound — `[1, 2]` appended once is 3 long, inside the bound, so the write lands (an unprovable grow is checked at run time and passes, O36 RULED S477).
rationale: §66.12.2: the length axis is "fixed · bounded (e.g. `1..=10`) · free"; §66.11.2: invariants "are checked on EVERY write". A grow that stays inside the bound is legal: one #go click appends 3 and sets @n to 3.
